nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Information Technology
nodes.description: Information Technology — Grade 10 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Information Technology Grade 10 Term 1 covering Basic Concepts of Computing, Data Representation, Algorithms, Solution Development and Social Implications.

nodes.title: Basic Concepts of Computing
nodes.description: Introduction to computers, digital technologies, information technology, general model of a computer, components of a computer system, types of computers, data and information, ICT systems, and overview of data, information and knowledge.

assessmentStandards: Explain what a computer is and basic usage
Define information technology and digital technologies
Overview of a general model of a computer
Overview of main components of a computer system
Overview of types of computers (purpose and uses)
Overview and link between data, information, and knowledge

nodes.title: Data Representation and Storage
nodes.description: Number systems and conversion, digital character representation (ASCII, Unicode), data types and their storage, data structures and collections of data storage.

assessmentStandards: Overview of digital character representation (ASCII, Unicode)
Overview of data types and their storage
Overview of data structures and collections of data storage

nodes.title: Algorithms
nodes.description: Basic concepts of algorithms, IPO tables and flow charts, producing and tracing algorithms, comparing algorithms in terms of sequence, precision and efficiency.

assessmentStandards: Basic IPO table and flow charts
Produce an algorithm to solve a problem
Trace an algorithm to determine the outcome using trace table
Compare algorithms in terms of sequence, precision and efficiency

nodes.title: Solution Development
nodes.description: Introduction to programming concepts including output, input, variables, operators, remainders, comparison operators, logical comparisons, functions, basic calculations, conditional constructs, string concatenation, casting, formatting of output, event handling, console and GUI programming.

assessmentStandards: Introduction to output, input, variables, operators
Retrieving remainders, comparison operators and performing logical comparisons
Functions, basic calculations, basic conditional constructs
Introduction to console programming, basic terms and development environment
Introduction to the programming tool (IDE, GUI, basic terms and development environment)

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Software licence agreements, piracy, copyright, copyleft, digital divide, economic reasons for using computers, social, ethical and legal issues pertaining to ICTs.

assessmentStandards: Software licence agreements, piracy, copyright, copyleft
Social, ethical, and legal issues pertaining to ICTs

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Information Technology Grade 10 Term 2 covering Systems Technologies, Software Engineering Principles, Solution Development, Communication Technologies and Social Implications.

nodes.title: Systems Technologies
nodes.description: Extended hardware concepts including input, output, storage, system unit, ports and connectors; differentiate primary vs secondary memory; compare devices of desktop and mobile devices; system software, utility programs, device drivers.

assessmentStandards: Extend hardware concepts (input, output, storage, input+output, system unit, ports and connectors and categorising)
Differentiate primary memory vs secondary memory
Compare input, processing, output, storage devices of a desktop computer with a small mobile device

nodes.title: Software Engineering Principles
nodes.description: Problem solving steps and techniques, applying problem solving techniques, use of appropriate tools and techniques used in software analysis.

assessmentStandards: Use appropriate tools and techniques used in software analysis

nodes.title: Solution Development
nodes.description: Conditional constructs (if, if-then-else, nested ifs, CASE statement), relational operators, string comparisons, basic validation techniques, events, debugging techniques and trace tables.

assessmentStandards: Comparison operators and performing logical comparisons: conditional constructs (if and if-then-else)
Nested ifs (three levels in the nesting)
Extend the use of variables, relational operators (and or not, IN)

nodes.title: Communication Technologies
nodes.description: Networks fundamentals, network components, communication media, network types (PAN, HAN, LAN, WLAN, WAN), Internet as a WAN, client-server vs peer-to-peer, electronic communication and e-mail.

assessmentStandards: List the essential basic network components: nodes, NIC, communication media, switch, router, NOS
Differentiate between client-server and peer-to-peer networks
Overview of applications and tools to facilitate e-communication
E-mail as a form of e-communication

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Ergonomics, green computing, health issues, e-communication accuracy, time, distance, communication costs and speed, how to use email best practices.

assessmentStandards: Ergonomics, green computing issues, health issues
E-communication in terms of accuracy, time, distance, communication costs, speed

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Information Technology Grade 10 Term 3 covering Internet Technologies, Solution Development (loops, string handling, application development), Computer Management, Social Implications and PAT.

nodes.title: Internet Technologies
nodes.description: Overview of the internet, connecting to the internet, overview of the World Wide Web (WWW), browsing and searching.

assessmentStandards: What is needed to connect to the internet
Overview of the World Wide Web (WWW)

nodes.title: Solution Development
nodes.description: Iteration and loops (For-loop, While-loop, Repeat-Until), string handling from first principles, applying string methods, implementing algorithms, developing simple applications with timer objects, animations.

assessmentStandards: Apply string methods to string handling
Implement algorithms to solve computing problems
Develop simple applications incorporating concepts covered
Make use of a timer object for simple animations

nodes.title: Computer Management
nodes.description: Overview of computer management, purpose of various management tasks and operating system utilities, general housekeeping tasks.

assessmentStandards: Overview and purpose of various management tasks and operating system utilities

nodes.title: Social Implications
nodes.description: Fake news, e-mail threats and issues, safe email and internet use, responsible communication styles and netiquette, online threats, POPIA.

nodes.title: Application Development (PAT)
nodes.description: Practical Assessment Task (PAT) phases including task description and analysis, task definition and user story, acceptance tests, navigation and flow between screens, screen design, IPO data and validation, creating and coding screens.

assessmentStandards: PAT: Task description and analysis of requirements
PAT: Task definition and user story

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Information Technology Grade 10 Term 4 covering Internet Services Technologies, Solution Development consolidation, Application Development and PAT completion, Final Examination.

nodes.title: Internet Technologies
nodes.description: Internet services technologies overview.

nodes.title: Solution Development
nodes.description: Consolidation and reinforcement of content, concepts and skills from Terms 1-3. Developing simple applications.

assessmentStandards: Consolidate and reinforce content, concepts, and skills

nodes.title: PAT Completion
nodes.description: PAT tasks including creating screens, developing code, input and output using text file, testing and data validation, documentation, and hand-in.

assessmentStandards: PAT: Input and output using text file (for PAT only)
